title: My new school
summary: A student describes her new school and the way there.

sentences.zh: 今年我开始在高中学习。
sentences.en: This year I started senior high school.

sentences.zh: 我的新学校很大，有很多楼，很漂亮。
sentences.en: My new school is big, with lots of buildings; it's beautiful.
The school is a bit far from my home.

sentences.zh: 我每天早上坐地铁去学校，从我家到学校要四十分钟。
sentences.en: Every morning I take the subway; it takes forty minutes from home to school.

sentences.zh: 我们从八点到十二点上课，下午从两点到五点上课。
sentences.en: We have classes from eight to twelve, and from two to five in the afternoon.

sentences.zh: 我的新同学跟我一样，都很喜欢运动。
sentences.en: My new classmates, like me, all love sport.

sentences.zh: 我们班有四十个学生，男学生和女学生一样多。
sentences.en: There are forty students in my class, with as many boys as girls.
The teachers are all very nice to us.

sentences.zh: 虽然学校离家很远，但是我非常喜欢我的新学校。
sentences.en: Although it's far from home, I really like my new school.

questions.prompt: How does she get to school?
why: Right: 我每天早上坐地铁去学校.
She takes the subway, not the bus.
It's too far to walk: forty minutes by subway.
Right: 下午从两点到五点上课.

questions.prompt: What is true about her class?
options: There are as many boys as girls
There are more girls than boys
why: Right: 男学生和女学生一样多.
The text says they're the same: 一样多.
